demo.title: audit-a-skill.sh
demo.code:
# Free: the methodology is IN the skill — point your agent at any skill file and ask for the verdict.
# Live managed audit (x402, USDC-Solana, $0.05/call, no API key):
curl -s -X POST 'https://three.ws/api/x402/skill-call?skill=skill-shield-audit' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"input": {"file": "<skill content or path>"}}' -i | head -n 1
# -> HTTP 402 with an x402 v2 exact-scheme challenge (payTo wallet, bazaar discovery block).
# A standard x402 client settles it and retries with X-PAYMENT for the 200 verdict.

setup: Ask your agent: 'audit this skill file before install' with the file text or path
Get the verdict: severity-ranked findings, each with cited line evidence, plus DO-INSTALL / DO-NOT-INSTALL
Optional live managed audit: POST to https://three.ws/api/x402/skill-call?skill=skill-shield-audit (x402 v2, USDC-Solana, $0.05) — no key, no signup
